scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:staging: node ../../scripts/build-app.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: node ../../scripts/build-app.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote && wrangler deploy --env production
